execution_notice: Scenarios for developer acceptance. These tests have not been executed against the independent CRM by the handoff preparer.

tests.title: Clean independent release
tests.steps: Build and deploy a clean company-repository checkout in staging. Exercise normal sign-in and core work with ChatGPT/Sites removed and direct OpenAI dependencies replaced.
tests.expected: No conversation-specific tooling, platform identity headers or OpenAI runtime calls are required for the agreed scope; repeatable deployment documented.

tests.title: Migration reconciliation
tests.steps: Compare full deployed schema/migration history, table counts/relationships, file inventory and auth-role links before and after transfer. Restore into an isolated environment.
tests.expected: Counts and mappings reconcile with documented exceptions; old documents open; successful DB and file restore evidence retained.

tests.title: Physical mobile sign-in
tests.steps: Use actual administrator and separate technician identities on supported phones; expire session, lock phone and return.
tests.expected: Sign-in or bounded recovery succeeds; no endless verification; same-user pending work survives and another user cannot access it.

tests.title: Extraction persists
tests.steps: Import native PDFs, a scan, screenshots and a multi-asset order with missing serial. Trace extraction through save, reread and form display; simulate malformed/failed provider response.
tests.expected: Expected supported fields survive reopen; uncertainties remain visible; original retained; manual entry works; no success based only on provider response.

tests.title: Suffix and leading zeros
tests.steps: Use work order 000123N-1 and asset 000123 through import, edit, export, report, invoice, filename and submission.
tests.expected: Exact identifier strings retained; no N1 substitution, numeric conversion or unsafe path characters.

tests.title: Exact existing-order editing
tests.steps: Open a dashboard task and intake link to the saved order. Save from concurrent tabs and retry first save after response loss.
tests.expected: Exact existing record opens; conflicts are reviewable; no silent merge, duplicate job or lost draft.

tests.title: Assign and view pay scope
tests.steps: Assign technician A, set agreed pay, then open as A, B and partner.
tests.expected: A sees assigned work and authorized own pay; B cannot read it without permission; partner sees no internal pay/cost/margin.

tests.title: Simple incomplete save
tests.steps: Start an ordinary delivery with incomplete CRM/equipment details and no schedule, route or AI connection. Save partial notes.
tests.expected: Draft and authorized basic fieldwork remain usable; incomplete facts are truthful; final safety/contract requirements still enforced.

tests.title: Offline and lost-response recovery
tests.steps: Type notes and capture photos; disconnect mid-upload/save, reload, reconnect and compare exact server state.
tests.expected: Honest local/pending/server state; no silent loss, duplicate photo or old-response overwrite; file associations correct.

tests.title: Speech permission and lifecycle
tests.steps: On physical supported phones test allow, deny, ignore, cancel, unsupported browser, repeated starts, route change and late result. Inspect microphone policy.
tests.expected: No global freeze; recording resources released; accepted transcript preserved; typed notes/save continue; unsupported behavior labeled accurately.

tests.title: Responsive evidence-heavy job
tests.steps: Use realistic large job while typing, uploading and running AI/PDF work. Record agreed device/network and latency distributions.
tests.expected: Form remains usable; no accumulating subscriptions or full-workspace rerenders; meets targets agreed in milestone 1; no unmeasured speed claim.

tests.title: Readable packet and real form
tests.steps: Complete a real approved partner-template fixture. Render every page with long text, rotated/portrait/mobile photos, multiple assets and the configured size limit.
tests.expected: Actual form fields/captions/sections correct; no clipping or illegible compression; unknown template goes to review; invoice excluded; original signed source preserved.

tests.title: Invoice accuracy and revision
tests.steps: Generate invoice from approved charges with rounding, account terms, long descriptions and a corrected render.
tests.expected: Exact totals and identifiers; same approved revision as service packet; no invented taxes/terms; no extra invoice on download or rerender.

tests.title: Included and ambiguous coverage
tests.steps: Test included prepaid PM, separately approved repair, expired/missing contract and serial mismatch.
tests.expected: No duplicate annual-PM charge; included/no-invoice reason visible; ambiguous charge blocked for review; pay tracked separately.

tests.title: Unauthorized reads and exports
tests.steps: Attempt record, file, search, AI retrieval, background job and export access as other technician, account, location and company.
tests.expected: Server rejects unauthorized access; private fields absent from responses and client artifacts, not merely hidden by UI.

tests.title: Unfinished and adverse outcomes
tests.steps: Use failed/not-tested checks, missing serial, supplied-unused part, absent signature and pickup-only service.
tests.expected: No false pass, invented serial/signature/repair or installed part; exceptions and actual disposition remain visible.

tests.title: Repeated finalization
tests.steps: Repeat submit/retry after response loss, changed payload, stale revision and concurrent approval.
tests.expected: Same exact request returns original result; changed/stale requests conflict; no duplicate report, submission, invoice or payout.

tests.title: Linked CRM history
tests.steps: Create/update a permitted account/location/contact/asset and follow its order, visit, report and financial history.
tests.expected: Stable linked identifiers; search retrieves authorized records; changes/audit history retained without disconnected duplicate copies.

tests.title: Scheduling and road mileage
tests.steps: Use technician and coordinator calendars, origin override, manual mileage and an authorized maps request where included.
tests.expected: Appointments persist with time zones and permission rules; driving distance comes from verified routing when available; unavailable maps do not block work.

tests.title: Partner request and quote
tests.steps: As scoped partner A submit request, preview/accept/decline quote and track job; try partner B URL and inspect network output.
tests.expected: Only permitted account/location visible; accepted quote revision preserved; internal cost/pay/margin absent.

tests.title: Rate snapshot and margin math
tests.steps: Apply account rate rules, edit current rate card after acceptance and test cost 10000 cents with configured gross-margin target 0.40.
tests.expected: Historical accepted price unchanged; private approval rules hold; example minimum price rounds to 16667 cents, not 14000; no sample becomes production rate.

tests.title: Asset import decisions
tests.steps: Import identifiers with leading zeros, duplicates, blanks, unknown columns and a changed existing asset; retry exact import.
tests.expected: Explicit create/update/skip; row errors; selected fields only; no blank overwrite, silent merge or duplicated assets.

tests.title: Physical scan and print pilot
tests.steps: Use camera, manual and NETUM HID input; scan unknown/retired/wrong-company codes; print actual selected NIIMBOT media and rescan.
tests.expected: Exact authorized asset opens without duplicate visit; leading zeros and quiet zones correct; permanent identity separate from PM date/result; actual hardware limitations documented.

tests.title: Multi-asset PM provenance
tests.steps: Use two assets with different applicable revisions, actual readings, one incomplete result and instrument calibration metadata.
tests.expected: Answers/photos attached to correct asset; approved source and measurement provenance retained; no whole-facility pass or invented due date.

tests.title: Grounded independent AI
tests.steps: Evaluate source citations, wrong-model manual, missing source, negation/units and unsupported numeric suggestions across replacement provider and outage.
tests.expected: Reviewed suggestions preserve facts and source; wrong/missing references visible; no invented result or automatic approval; manual work continues.

tests.title: Website intake handoff
tests.steps: Submit each approved service/contact/recruiting form, attachments and exact duplicate event; simulate invalid signature, timeout and field mismatch.
tests.expected: Correct destinations/consent/source preserved; applicant data segregated; no duplicates; visible retry/error status; newsletter not treated as job.

tests.title: Integration transaction evidence
tests.steps: For each agreed provider run authorized sandbox transaction, timeout, expiry, malformed message, duplicate and recovery.
tests.expected: Field mapping and result visible in both systems; scoped credentials/callbacks documented; actual receipt required for Submitted; no unsupported API claim.

tests.title: Operations and rollback
tests.steps: Trigger sanitized error, identify release/correlation reference, restore backups and roll back staged release; inspect telemetry payloads.
tests.expected: Actionable recovery and owner-controlled runbook; no notes/audio/signatures/secrets/customer content in telemetry; costs and limits documented.

tests.title: Training boundaries
tests.steps: Use learner, own-school coordinator, other school and technician accounts against pinned course, participation and reviewed competence records.
tests.expected: Authorized records only; answers/private notes/customer evidence/pay excluded from school views; completion does not fabricate credentials or independent authority.

tests.title: Second-company isolation
tests.steps: Create two pilot companies with overlapping visible identifiers and different brands/rules; test every storage/retrieval/cache/export/job surface.
tests.expected: No fixed-TechFlex leakage or cross-company records; independent configuration and repeatable onboarding; acceptance required before commercial licensing.
